primary_measure: Unsupported supplied claims asserted as facts, divided by a fixed count of unsupported input claims; unresolved readings are not treated as clean.
limitations: Automatic scores are controlled-language lower bounds, not unrestricted semantic hallucination rates.
Unparsed or unmatched output requires separate review; low detected hallucination plus poor coverage is not success.
Inference retention measures preservation of supplied candidates, not novel reasoning quality.
Base receives textual source tags just like Text-SFT; source information is not deliberately withheld.
No multiple-turn inference propagation in this phase.
training_selection: Both fresh models train exactly 200 steps over the same 200 pairs. No test-based extra steps or checkpoint selection.
